children: Fog Cutter Holdings, LLC disclosed a 25.6% stake in Tavia Acquisition Corp.’s ordinary shares. The transaction closed on Oct. 1, 2026, following a Sept. 29 agreement to acquire founder shares and private units from Tavia Sponsor Pte. Ltd. The deal makes Fog Cutter the new sponsor and installs Andrew A. Wiederhorn as chairman and CEO, signaling active oversight.

Fog Cutter bought the shares to take over as Tavia Acquisition’s sponsor and to guide the SPAC’s next phase. The agreement also led to leadership changes: Andrew A. Wiederhorn joined the board as chairman and became CEO, while Kenneth Kuick became CFO.

Fog Cutter assumed key ongoing duties tied to the SPAC’s life cycle, including “funding the monthly contributions to the Issuer's trust account” for extensions. The firm says it will review its investment over time and may adjust its holdings as it evaluates strategy and market conditions.

Fog Cutter Holdings, LLC is a Delaware limited liability company that agreed to serve as the sponsor of Tavia Acquisition Corp. The firm is affiliated with executive Andrew A. Wiederhorn and typically invests through control and sponsor roles. Its principals have experience leading and financing consumer and restaurant platforms, including through public-company transactions.
